name: National AI Fund Act
description: Establishes a public fund to finance research and development of deep learning algorithms

name: National Natural Language Plan
description: A government programme to develop systems for understanding and generating human language

name: Multimodal Sensor Regulation
description: Legislation regulating the use of integrated perception systems in public spaces

name: Public Digital Archiving Act
description: Establishes a national data archiving system for AI with security guarantees

name: Causal Reasoning
description: The capacity to understand complex cause-and-effect relationships

name: Reinforcement Learning
description: A system that improves through trial and error

name: Real-Time Processing
description: The capacity to process information and respond instantaneously

name: National AI Ethics Committee Act
description: Establishes an independent body that verifies AI decisions against ethical principles

name: Algorithmic Transparency Act
description: Requires companies to explain AI decisions in a manner comprehensible to citizens

name: National Anti-Bias Plan
description: A government programme to identify and correct bias in public AI systems

name: Differential Privacy Regulation
description: Legislation imposing privacy-protection techniques in public datasets

name: Modular Architecture of Public Systems Act
description: Legislation requiring flexible, updatable systems for AI in the public sector

name: National Federated Learning Plan
description: A government programme to develop distributed learning systems that preserve privacy

name: Continuous AI Monitoring Regulation
description: Legislation establishing constant surveillance of the performance and behaviour of public AI

name: Human-AI Collaboration Act
description: Establishes standards for systems that facilitate collaboration between citizens and AI in public services

name: Ethical Amendment
description: An amendment that doubles the ethical impact of the next political decision

name: Industry Agreement
description: An agreement that doubles the technological impact of the next law

name: Majority Coalition
description: A coalition that doubles progress towards sustainable AI

name: Bipartisan Consensus
description: A cross-party agreement that adds +5 points to all objectives

name: Support of Ethics Groups
description: Public backing that multiplies ethics by 1.5 and adds +3 to progress
